intro: Speak with Belann directs aspiring spellcasters to Valanaar to meet master artisan Belann Windwood. As an initiate's magical mastery expands, crafting a personal spell focus marks an essential rite of passage under the storied traditions of the High Order.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring adventurers. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.
Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you must be friend? It is heartening to see young adventurers eager to learn our ways and history. Come, I will explain the next steps to crafting your spell focus.
